sources.excerpt: The 2026 Melbourne Cup, known commercially as the 2026 Lexus Melbourne Cup, was the 166th running of the Melbourne Cup, an Australian thoroughbred horse race.
The race, ran over 3,200 metres (1.988 mi), was held on 3 November 2026 at Melbourne's Flemington Racecourse.
The winner of the 2026 Melbourne Cup was Point of Law, jockeyed by Ethan Brown.

The Miguel de Cervantes Prize (Spanish: Premio de Literatura en Lengua Castellana Miguel de Cervantes) is awarded annually to honour the lifetime achievement of an outstanding writer in the Spanish language.
The winner receives a monetary award of €125,000, which makes it one of the richest literary prizes in the world.
The prize was established in 1975 by the Ministry of Culture of Spain and first awarded the following year.
Cristina Fernández Cubas (born 1945) is a Spanish writer and journalist.
Fernández Cubas practised journalism from an early age and published her first collection of short stories, Mi hermana Elba, in 1980.
Spanish author Cristina Fernández Cubas is awarded the Cervantes Prize.

The Reserve Bank of Australia raises its benchmark interest rate by 0.25 percentage points to 4.85%, its highest level since 2008, citing persistent inflation and rising energy costs associated with the Iran war.
A new study reveals all five fundamental nucleobases – the molecular “letters” of life – have been detected in samples from the asteroid Ryugu.
The Ryugu samples were returned from space in 2020 by Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency’s (JAXA) Hayabusa2 mission.
Hayabusa2 delivered a total of 5.4 grams of pristine asteroid material.
